implemented: Content-addressed premarket-frozen policy covers quote freshness/spread, displayed size, ADV participation/freshness, costs versus expected net alpha, projected exposure, and model confidence.
The evaluator returns named fail-closed checks, reason codes, evidence identities, and a canonical verdict digest suitable for the runner risk callback.
The runner durably records explicit no-trade/rejected and missed/rejected execution outcomes as immutable PAPER_SKIP records with decision, risk, preflight, signal and source-input attribution.
Replay rejects a changed skip record and does not call execution for pre-trade risk refusals.

Registered paper sessions may bind a pre-trade policy digest into session identity; the bridge requires the exact policy and snapshot adapter, validates strategy/version and visible-input identity, combines the gate with risk, and persists its verdict.
The bridge requires the supplied pre-trade quote digest to match a decision-visible market event already journaled for that session.
blockers: Pre-trade policy binding is optional at the session level; all strategy/session configurations are not yet required to declare one.
Authoritative ADV/cost feeds, a reconciled portfolio exposure book, calibrated confidence, and formal eligibility wiring remain unverified.
